rules.title: Hoboken ban on rent-coordinating software
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.key_value: ban on software/algorithms/data-sharing platforms coordinating rents, lease terms or occupancy
rules.citation: Hoboken City Code ch. 158, Art. II
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy
rules.effective_date_note: Law-firm alert says 'effective July 2025'; exact day not given. Official ordinance text (ecode360 link-only) not captured.
rules.conflict_note: NJ FAIR Act (P.L.2026, c.43) may preempt this ordinance once it takes effect (7/1/2027); not discussed in the source document.

parsed.notes: Only the algorithmic rent-setting ordinance is supported by provided text. Three Hoboken ecode360 pages (D032-D034) are link-only with no captured text, so I added no rules from them for other categories. A Hoboken rent control ordinance likely exists, but I could not confirm it from the documents. I added no no-rule findings because the documents don't show that any category lacks a rule.
